description: This file defines an interface for managing a stack of signal handlers. It provides function prototypes for pushing and popping signal handlers on a per-signal basis, as well as for managing a common set of signals. The code includes documentation on how to use the signal chain to ensure proper cleanup and restoration of previous signal handlers.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a custom signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the top signal handler from the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for a predefined set of common signals (SIGINT, SIGHUP, etc.).

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Removes handlers for the common signals.
